sections.title: The four linked 24-chapter Word guidebooks and interactive HTML books are expanded from source-only
sections.text: The four linked 24-chapter Word guidebooks and interactive HTML books are expanded from source-only source-backed material. These are not a rewrite of the eight full novels, nor are the games production-complete. Previous integrated builds were not used as canon. The original MMORPG archived 'Duplicate Aza_ra MMORPG Guide Book.docx' was consulted for document organization, not for obsolete lore.

sections.title: Source Review includes a 25+ name research concordance that separates strict-JSON species, historic
sections.text: Source Review includes a 25+ name research concordance that separates strict-JSON species, historic communities and unapproved archival candidates. The count is not a declaration that 25 species are approved. Source Review also includes 240 indexed, untitled manuscript slots, not fabricated completed chapters.

sections.title: To run the JavaScript modules, start a local server from this directory using `python -m http.server
sections.text: To run the JavaScript modules, start a local server from this directory using `python -m http.server 8000`, then open Code/word-generator/index.html, Code/ttrpg/index.html or Code/mmorpg/index.html. Word generator includes a separate script workbench; the tabletop folder includes a 5,000-point Shaping Hall planner.
